restoration: Resolve repositoryPath from repository root. For exact-bytes mappings verify original SHA and copy to logicalPath in a fresh logical root. Explicit companions preserve original SHA/length but cannot recreate private originals; they are not native reports. Reused14 original reports retain their established publication maps. No ZIP or browser profile.
